words.gloss: we are highly esteemed and accepted

literal: "We are highly accepted," thinking thus, unacceptable deeds they will not do, those of unwavering clear understanding.
translation: Those of unwavering, clear wisdom will not perform unacceptable deeds, presuming, "We have been highly favored and accepted by the ruler."
modern: "நாம் அரசரால் ஏற்றுக்கொள்ளப்பட்டுவிட்டோம்" என்று எண்ணிக் கொண்டு, செய்யத்தகாத செயல்களைத் தெளிவான அறிவுடையவர்கள் செய்யமாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet advises ministers and courtiers on how to behave when they enjoy the ruler's favor. People of unwavering clarity and wisdom ('துளக்கற்ற காட்சியவர்') never let their privileged position get to their heads. They do not presume upon their closeness to the ruler ('கொளப்பட்டேம் என்று எண்ணி') to commit improper or forbidden acts ('கொள்ளாத செய்யார்'). Their steady intellect keeps them mindful that royal favor is no license for transgression.
